Entries.Text: Couldn't read the vanilla MSB of {0}, so it isn't compared with vanilla.

Colour the objects in Map Contents that differ from the vanilla map (modified) or that the vanilla map doesn't have (added). Objects are matched by list and name, so a renamed object counts as added. You can change the colours in the theme.
{0} has no vanilla MSB (the project added it), so there is nothing to compare with.
The vanilla map has no object of this type with this name, so it was added (or renamed).
Revert every field listed below to its vanilla value, as one undoable step. The name is kept, because objects are matched by name.
Revert {0} to its vanilla value. You can undo this.
List what the active map changes from the vanilla map: modified objects, added objects, and vanilla objects no longer in it, which you can restore.
Load a map, or select an object in one, to compare it.
Compare the active map with its vanilla MSB.
Parts, regions and events, matched with vanilla by list and name. Lights and other map files aren't compared.
The compared map was unloaded. Compare again.
The map was edited after this comparison. Compare again to update it.
Select and frame the object. Properties > Compare with Vanilla lists what changed.
The object no longer exists. Compare again.
Restore the vanilla object to the map, as it is in vanilla. You can undo this.
"{0}" wasn't restored: {1} already has an object of that type with that name.
